venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.weather: Cool, rain most of the evening
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Friday 10/9 (MOD JK).** Net sales $4,697 vs target $7,083 (-33.7%). Food $444. 159 guests, $29.54 check avg. Comps $271. Smooth Friday; new bartender Raven's first day behind the bar. Tropical storm Isaias arrived ~9:30pm and likely hurt business; slight push ~10pm, most cleared out by midnight. Slower night allowed more intentional guest interaction. Furniture brought inside as a precaution against wind gusts. Favorite moment: guests complimenting Halloween decorations and lighting.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.weather: Nice, good temp and clear skies
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Friday 10/9 (MOD & Chef KK KE JMS).** Net sales $12,166 vs target $10,973 (+10.9%). Food $441. 388 guests, $31.36 check avg. Comps $139 / 1.15%. Early pop gave a good start; good crowd by 8pm persisting to 11pm with a later evening pop. Slightly later last call due to guests in house; late-night scene popping again. Kitchen: smooth sailing. 86: Taco Tuesday. Favorite moment: Joe's friends celebrating a birthday with a good-sized party.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Friday 10/9 (AM MOD Carey; PM MOD & Chef Maggie H).** Net sales incl. events $21,012.69 vs target $17,134 (+22.6%). DC/AM $880.74, D&C PM $12,691.72, Garden/6A $3,491.65; base net $17,152.69; net event sales $3,860. Food incl. events $5,839. 410 guests (Tock). Comps $698.79. Steady night and end of the 2026 Garden season (lots of events booked this month). Event: American Board of Obesity Medicine, 20 guests, 8am–5pm in Vauxhall, breakfast and lunch spread, went smoothly. Kitchen: chill Friday; 911: preserved lemon aioli, creamed spinach, sliced scallops, lime crumble; low: honey butter, pasta dough, braised rabbit, wagyu flanks, cookie dough.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Friday 10/9 (MOD & Chef Seth / Will).** Net sales $7,778 vs target $7,674 (+1.4%). Food $719, beverage $7,059. 244 guests, $32 check avg. Comps $260.97. Smooth flow; two- and three-heavy 6pm turn, pace accelerated by 8pm, key larger parties energized the room; standing room used for parties >2. Door: long line at open, waitlist ~25 parties by 10pm, many large parties not seated; last party of 4 seated 1:35am. 1 no-show (charged). Top sellers: Rosalie, Paper Wasp, Eight Limb Daiquiri. Breakage: 1 DOF, 1 candle votive.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Friday 10/9 (MOD & Chef Gigi, Julian, Joe, Angel, Saleh).** Net sales $12,306 vs target $11,566 (+6.4%). Marquee $9,603, Standing Room $2,703; food $2,185. 307 guests, $89.83 check avg (as reported). Comps $375 (friends, industry, investors, birthdays, anniversaries, DNL). Steady Friday: 129 covers to start, standing room opened ~7pm, biggest rush 8–11pm at nearly $2.5k/hour, smaller waitlist than normal, lull around midnight as guests moved to Marquee. Maintenance: water still coming out room temperature. No-shows charged.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Friday 10/9 (MOD Marcus / Josh).** Net sales incl. events $12,077.42 vs target $8,414 (+43.5%). Marquee bar $9,404.04, Garden $2,890; food $2,890. 266 guests, GCA $39.99 (CA $80.24). Comps $216.62. Great weather drew guests to the patio; big push ~8pm and again ~10pm, Uncle Bones's birthday celebration in the Garden, waitlist worked and all but one group seated. Needs: running drinks, water service, clearing KDS. Kitchen close not checked. Maintenance: curtains, service well, ADA bathroom lock. No-show revenue $60. Surprise visit from former GM Kevin.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.weather: Breezy and cool morning, drizzly but pleasant evening
venues.narrative: **MG — Friday 10/9 (AM MOD & Chef Sam & Marcus; PM James & Marcus).** Net sales $20,028 vs target $12,346 (+62.2%). Morning bar $3,138, evening bar $9,252, Hot Eye $2,524, Sun Club closed. Food $4,756; event sales $4,968. 317 guests (77 AM + 240 PM OpenTable), $63.18 check avg. Comps $189. Slow morning then normal Friday lunch with three large food tours. Evening busy: event crunched onto the mezzanine last minute, concert at Enmarket, Lucas Theatre screening, weddings. Hot Eye full till ~11 with overflow from events; one guest fell from a barstool (no injury reported). Hot Eye 1 year anniversary week.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.narrative: **SEA — Friday 10/9 (MOD Julian Abel).** Net sales $11,492 vs target $11,000 (+4.5%). Food $1,953. 252 guests, $45.60 check avg. Comps ~$700 (~$300 shifties and industry/community discounts, rest DNL and SND). Rain kept people from hanging out front. Chill start ramping to full-force Friday; Amber held down a section and Taylor trained. Kitchen: good job, family meal had.
